subject.title: fix: classify provider code-only failover errors

question: Should maintainers accept these provider-native code mappings as the intended failover and cooldown semantics for OpenAI, Google-family, and Anthropic code-only errors?
rationale: The patch is code-correct and follows the provider boundary, but the mapping choices influence provider routing/cooldown behavior for existing users and need owner acceptance before landing.

options.title: Land Provider-Hook Ownership
options.body: Accept the current mappings because vendor-specific code policy lives in provider hooks and the PR includes focused proof and tests.

options.title: Refresh Merge Proof First
options.body: Ask for or perform a current-base merge inspection if maintainers want extra assurance that newer main changes around failover classification are preserved.

options.title: Pause For Provider Semantics
options.body: Pause only if an owner wants different failover reasons for one of the vendor codes, such as treating a code as server_error instead of timeout.

recommendation.title: Land Provider-Hook Ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the current mappings because vendor-specific code policy lives in provider hooks and the PR includes focused proof and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete and his recent provider-boundary history is closest to the accept-or-adjust decision.
